8.20.12. iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.CustomTableMethodImplementation¶

class iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.CustomTableMethodImplementation¶

Base class for user supplied table methods.

Subclasses must implement two methods, rows and arity. In addition to these methods, you may override validateAgainstPackageData in case your table method operates on other tables and need to know type information about them.

The following attributes are available to subclasses:

  • railyard: The railyard (IRailyard).

You may also call the predefined method getTable(name) to get the LCF table with the given name. This is the preferred method of reading table data, as it works also for locally defined tables and table method pipelines.

Example usage:

@arguments(degree=int)
class ObjectsInNodesOfDegreeN(CustomTableMethodImplementation):
    def init(self, degree):
        assert degree > 0, "'degree' must be greater than zero."
        self._degree = degree

    def rows(self):
        rows = set()
        for node in self.railyard.Graph.Nodes:
          if rows.Degree == self._degree:
            for obj in node.Objects:
              rows.add((obj,))

        return rows

    def arity(self):
        return 1
